name: Logout Denied: How I, the Beta Tester, Became Trapped in a Futanari-Dominated VR Simulation
source:
"Logout Denied: How I, the Beta Tester, Became Trapped in a Futanari-Dominated VR Simulation" is an Adult Visual Novel in development primarily focused on Futadom (Futa on Male), with some Femdom and Trapdom planned .

A horny guy lands a paid gig as a Full Dive VR Beta Tester for a “Multiverse Eroge Beta VR Game,” expecting standard hentai-style adventures. Once inside the simulation, he realizes it’s not the kind of eroge he signed up for. He can’t log out, and his protests are met with a machine-like System Window pop-up visible only to him. He will be deployed to multiple universes. Each release will focusing on a specific character(s)/universe.​

[From [url=https://naughtymosquito.itch.io/logout-denied]Itch.io[/url]]
